signals.label: Lifetime definition
signals.finding: The vendor may discontinue the product, which ends a lifetime deal.

evidence.quote: we may modify or discontinue a product temporarily or permanently with or without any notice.

signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: Usage is metered (credits or quotas) on the vendor's pages.

evidence.quote: You can host unlimited courses and students on the free version for as long as you want, and only upgrade to Pro when you need advanced capabilities.

signals.label: Review trend
signals.finding: Newest 20 reviews average 3.95/5 vs 4.28/5 all-time (-0.33). 21% of all reviews are 1-2 stars.

signals.label: Tier trap
signals.finding: The cheapest tier is a usable slice of the product.

signals.label: Vendor age & track record
signals.finding: Domain is about 5.4 years old. Sold on AppSumo 2 times before.

signals.label: Discount size
signals.finding: $59 vs a stated $1428 regular price (96% off).

signals.label: One-sided change clauses
signals.finding: The terms let the vendor change features or pricing at any time.

evidence.quote: Academy LMS holds the right to modify the price from time to time or at any time.
Note: We are not obligated to provide prior notification if we decide to amend or modify the terms and conditions at any point in the future.

finePrint.summary: Lifetime means how long the product itself is available, not the buyer's lifetime.

quote.text: The word “Lifetime” refers to the amount of time that the product will be available. It does not imply the lifespan of the purchaser or any other assumption that may be made about the period.

finePrint.summary: The vendor can end a product's lifetime with 30 to 90 days notice.

quote.text: Academy LMS retains the right to notify the customers between 30 and 90 days’ notice before announcing that a product’s lifetime has come to an end.

finePrint.summary: A full refund requires reporting a valid bug within 14 days and the team failing to fix it within 48 hours.

quote.text: If our support team is unable to resolve a reported issue within 48 hours of receiving the report, you will be eligible for a full refund, provided the issue is reported within 14 days of purchase.

finePrint.summary: All refund requests must be submitted within 14 days of purchase.

quote.text: Note: All refund requests or claims must be submitted within 14 days of purchase.

finePrint.summary: Refunds are only available within 14 days and only if an unresolved valid bug is not fixed in 48 hours.

quote.text: If you encounter a valid bug or issue that we’re unable to resolve within 48 hours, you’re eligible for a refund within 14 days of purchase.

finePrint.summary: The vendor can amend terms at any time without prior notification.

quote.text: Note: We are not obligated to provide prior notification if we decide to amend or modify the terms and conditions at any point in the future.

finePrint.summary: The vendor can change prices at any time.

quote.text: Academy LMS holds the right to modify the price from time to time or at any time.

finePrint.summary: The vendor can modify or discontinue a product temporarily or permanently with or without notice.

quote.text: we may modify or discontinue a product temporarily or permanently with or without any notice.

finePrint.summary: The vendor can immediately suspend accounts for license abuse or harm to its business.

quote.text: We hold the right to suspend access to your user account immediately if we find out that you are trying to take advantage of our license and abuse it or harm our business in any way.

finePrint.summary: Support continues even after a license expires.

quote.text: Even if the license expires, we will continue to support that client.

finePrint.summary: Buyers are entitled to ask for help with any issue while using the product.

quote.text: After downloading a product of Academy LMS, you are entitled to ask for help with any issue that you face while using one of our product (s).

finePrint.summary: The free version allows unlimited courses and students for as long as desired.

quote.text: You can host unlimited courses and students on the free version for as long as you want, and only upgrade to Pro when you need advanced capabilities.

trials.claim: Seller promises all future Individual, Business Plus or Agency plan updates
trials.claimQuote: All future Individual (Tier 1), Business Plus (Tier 2) or Agency (Tier 3-4) Plan updates
trials.reasoning: The binding terms define lifetime only as how long the product is available and allow the vendor to end that lifetime on 30-90 days' notice. That materially limits the promise of all future plan updates, outweighing the marketing line about lifetime updates.

exhibits.quote: The word “Lifetime” refers to the amount of time that the product will be available.
exhibits.argument: The quote redefines lifetime as product availability rather than perpetual updates.

exhibits.quote: Academy LMS retains the right to notify the customers between 30 and 90 days’ notice before announcing that a product’s lifetime has come to an end.
exhibits.argument: The vendor can terminate lifetime coverage on 30-90 days notice, voiding future updates.

exhibits.quote: Benefit from lifetime updates to ensure your platform stays current and secure.
exhibits.argument: Vendor promises lifetime updates keeping the platform current, supporting future plan updates.

trials.claim: Build SCORM-ready courses, sell bundles and memberships, and engage learners with certificates and gamification
trials.claimQuote: Build SCORM-ready courses, sell bundles and memberships, and engage learners with certificates and gamification
trials.reasoning: A lifetime-deal buyer reports that installing the SCORM add-on required buying the LMS again monthly, annually, or as another lifetime deal. That directly conflicts with SCORM being included as promised, despite the vendor describing SCORM import and bundles.

exhibits.quote: After purchasing the Lifetime Deal via AppSumo when accessing the add-ons to install the SCORM functionality it requires you to buy the LMS AGAIN either paying monthly, annually, or buy another lifetime deal on their website.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports SCORM is not included and requires paying again despite SCORM-ready claim.

exhibits.quote: Import existing SCORM and H5P courses. Progress syncs automatically in Academy.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms SCORM courses can be imported with progress syncing.

exhibits.quote: Combine multiple courses into one bundle and sell them at a single, fixed price.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms bundles of courses can be built and sold.

trials.claim: Seller promises AI course generation and instant course building from YouTube content
trials.claimQuote: Generate courses with AI, or build one instantly from YouTube content
trials.reasoning: A buyer reports a lack of AI features, directly conflicting with the AI course-generation promise. No exhibit supports instant course building from YouTube content.

exhibits.quote: Overall, the lack of AI features and slow processing makes Academy LMS feel outdated and inefficient.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports lack of AI features, contradicting AI course generation promise.

exhibits.quote: Build complete courses faster with AI, from lessons to learning content.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms AI can build complete courses from lessons to content.

trials.claim: Seller promises multi-step builder with lessons, chapters, quizzes, assignments and import/export
trials.claimQuote: Structure lessons, chapters, quizzes, and assignments in a multi-step builder, and import or export lessons and quizzes
trials.reasoning: The vendor confirms drag-and-drop building with lessons, quizzes, and assignments, plus a reusable question pool with CSV import and export. Reviews calling editing confusing or quizzes buggy complain about quality, not that these features are absent.

exhibits.quote: It's confusing, the course editing is bad, the flow is unattractive.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports course editing is bad and confusing, undermining builder claim.

exhibits.quote: While I did run into some weird bugs and glitches with the Quiz plugin
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports bugs and glitches with quizzes, undermining quiz builder reliability.

exhibits.quote: Drag and drop lessons, quizzes, and assignments to build your curriculum.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms builder structures lessons, quizzes and assignments.

exhibits.quote: One shared pool of questions, reusable across every quiz, with CSV import and export.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms reusable question bank with import and export.

trials.claim: Seller allows upgrading between 4 license tiers while deal is available
trials.claimQuote: Ability to upgrade between 4 license tiers while the deal is available
trials.reasoning: The vendor says buyers can upgrade at any time by paying the difference, and a buyer confirms upgrading to Tier 4. The generic right to change terms or discontinue a product does not directly contradict upgrading while the deal is available.

exhibits.quote: Also, we may modify or discontinue a product temporarily or permanently with or without any notice.
exhibits.argument: The vendor can discontinue products without notice, undermining guaranteed upgrades.

exhibits.quote: We are not obligated to provide prior notification if we decide to amend or modify the terms and conditions at any point in the future.
exhibits.argument: The vendor can change terms without notice, allowing withdrawal of upgrade rights.

exhibits.quote: Yes, you can upgrade at any time, but you’ll need to pay the required amount for the new package.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states buyers can upgrade to a different package at any time.

exhibits.quote: I have recently upgraded to tier4 to support this team.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms upgrading to tier4 was possible.
